# Fishing Spots Within ~2 Hours of Florence, SC

> Researched 10/11/2026 from SCDNR, SC State Parks, pier sites, USFWS, county parks.
> Drive = OSRM routing estimate from downtown Florence (tends to run long; check Google Maps for live times).
> Your own private spots go in the app only. They never belong in this public repo.

## Saltwater: license note

You need an SC saltwater license (16+) for everything below **except** fishing *on* a pier that carries a blanket license
(e.g. Myrtle Beach State Park Pier). Jetties, surf, docks and the MarshWalk are **not** covered by pier licenses.

## Eating advisories (SCDES): read before keeping freshwater fish

**SCDES: children under 14 and pregnant or nursing women should eat NO fish from any water with an advisory.**
Most Pee Dee-area rivers have one. Check the live map before keeping fish: https://gis.des.sc.gov/fishadvisories (table below is from the 2020 SCDES table).

| Water / spot | Advisory |
|---|---|
| Great Pee Dee River: US 76/301 Bridge Landing | Great Pee Dee (check which segment): NC line→I-95 (PCB+mercury) blue cat 1/month; bowfin, largemouth, redear 1/week. I-95→Winyah Bay: bowfin & largemouth 1/month, redear 1/week. Kids under 14: don't eat. |
| Lynches River County Park | Lynches (US 15→Pee Dee): DO NOT EAT bowfin or channel catfish; pickerel & largemouth 1/month; redear 1/week; bluegill & redbreast OK. Kids under 14: don't eat. |
| Prestwood Lake (Lawton Park) | Largemouth 1 meal/week (SCDES). Kids under 14: don't eat. |
| Lake Robinson | DO NOT EAT bowfin; largemouth 1/month; bluegill, pickerel, warmouth 1/week. Kids under 14: don't eat. |
| Lee State Park | Lynches River (US 15→Pee Dee): DO NOT EAT bowfin or channel catfish. Artesian Lake not separately listed. Kids under 14: don't eat river fish. |
| Lake Ashwood (SCDNR) | Largemouth 1 meal/week. Kids under 14: don't eat. |
| Little Pee Dee State Park | Park lake not listed. The Little Pee Dee RIVER: DO NOT EAT blue/flathead cat, bowfin, pickerel, largemouth; others 1/week. |
| Cheraw State Park (Lake Juniper) | Lake Juniper not in the SCDES table. |
| Black River State Park (The Meadows) | Black River: DO NOT EAT largemouth; bowfin & pickerel 1/month; crappie, blue cat, bream, warmouth 1/week. Kids under 14: don't eat. |
| Santee State Park (Lake Marion) | Lake Marion: bowfin & largemouth 1/week; others unrestricted. |
| Santee NWR (Lake Marion) | Lake Marion: bowfin & largemouth 1/week. |
| Lake Moultrie: Fred L. Day Pier | Lake Moultrie: bowfin 1/week; others unrestricted. |
| Lake Wateree State Park | PCB advisory: catfish, largemouth, striper, white bass 1/month; crappie 1/week. Kids under 14: don't eat. |
| Lake Murray: Saluda Dam North Rec Area pier | Lake Murray not in the SCDES table. |

## Closed / skip for now

- **Lake Wallace (Bennettsville)**: Dam breached May & July 2024; lake drained. $25M allocated, rebuild expected to start 2027.
- **Dargan's Pond (SCDNR, Darlington Co.)**: Closed.
- **Pawleys Island Pier**: Destroyed by Hurricane Ian (2022). Rebuild ~14–18 months from ~Sept 2026.

## North Carolina

SC licenses are **not** valid in NC waters (Sunset Beach, Ocean Isle, Lake Waccamaw). NC has no reciprocity with SC.
